title: I used Tripo AI to create frozen industrial assets for my demolition derby game
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
I'm developing Brutal Derby, a vehicular combat and destruction game in Unity, entirely on my own.

Meet Frozen Hell, one of the demolition derby arenas in my game!

For this frozen industrial battleground, I used Tripo AI to create several environment assets, including:

* A massive frozen crane with a wrecking ball
* Snow-covered stadium floodlights
* Rusty, ice-covered shipping containers
* Weathered concrete barriers covered in snow

I wanted the arena to feel like an abandoned industrial facility that has been completely frozen over, but is now being used for brutal vehicle battles.

As a solo developer, creating all these unique assets manually would take a significant amount of time. Tripo AI helps me speed up the 3D modeling process so I can focus more on vehicle physics, destruction, weapons, and gameplay.

The assets are integrated into my Unity environment alongside the rest of the game's systems.

Here are some of the 3D models created for Frozen Hell!

What do you think of the frozen industrial atmosphere?

Tripo AI: [https://www.tripo3d.ai/](https://www.tripo3d.ai/)

**Disclosure:** This post is part of a paid collaboration with Tripo AI.
